# tratree

> tratree is a travel company that brings the world to you — affordable holiday packages, resort & bus booking, and curated tours for students, families, and couples. Contact us for international and couples packages.

## Services

- Holiday Packages — curated multi-day tour packages for all budgets
- Resort Booking — handpicked resort stays with travel arrangements
- Bus Booking — comfortable group bus travel for tours and trips
- Students Package — affordable group tour packages for student groups
- Family Package — memorable family vacation packages, domestic and outstation
- International Package — overseas tour packages (contact for enquiry)
- Couples Package — romantic getaway packages (contact for enquiry)

## About

tratree was born from a simple idea: a tree that dreams of travelling. A bird lands on its branch, offers a deal — give me a nest, I'll tell you everything I see. tratree is that bird. We bring stories, places, and experiences to those who seek to travel.
